defaults.video_script: In June 2022, Georgina gave birth to twins. Their baby son didn't survive the birth. Their daughter did. Ronaldo named her Bella Esmeralda, and later said she became his reason to keep getting out of bed during the darkest months of his career. He's described holding her for the first time as the moment grief and love collided. Years later, he still posts her laughing in his arms, like nothing was ever lost.
